name: Sunnybank Juices
description: Fruit juice and smoothie producer in the fictional town of Orchardleigh.

items.title: Published sugar content ruling
items.content: The advertising watchdog publicly ruled on 2026-03-03 that Sunnybank's 'no added sugar' smoothie ad was misleading because a 330 ml bottle holds 31.5 g of sugar. Ruling SBJ-ASA-0303.

items.title: Recycling scheme
items.content: Return 12 empty bottles to any stockist for a free smoothie; bottles are 100% recycled plastic. Scheme SBJ-REC-12.

items.title: Pressing schedule
items.content: Apples are pressed from 05:45 in 3 runs; the press operator, Tegan Rhys, logs Brix readings in SBJ-PRS-545.

items.title: Sample policy
items.content: Staff may take 4 bottles a week; samples for events are signed out in SBJ-SMP-4.

items.title: Orchard supply contract
items.content: Pippin Hill Orchards supplies 1,900 tonnes of apples a year at $416 per tonne until 2028-09-30. Contract SBJ-ORC-0930-P.

items.title: New flavour launch
items.content: Sunnybank will launch Blood Orange and Ginger on 2027-04-19 with a $340,000 campaign; the recipe uses 7.5% ginger juice. Plan SBJ-NPD-0419-B.
